title: Stop older iPhones crashing, and add error pages that recover
hypothesis: Visitors on Safari before 16.4 can use every page; failed script loads recover instead of leaving a blank page.

baseline.note: Emulated old Safari crashed 79 of 115 sitemap pages on production (2026-10-14); crashed pages sent no analytics, so there is no measured baseline.

decision_rule: Keep unless the live smoke test or site_error data shows the error pages misfiring.
